title: Seahawks' Super Bowl dominance proves defense can play a lead role in a box-office hit

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks' Super Bowl dominance proves defense can play a lead role in a box-office hit
sources.description: Dominance is fun, even when it leads to a low-scoring game. There aren't many defenses that feel like must-see television, but the Seahawks had that appeal all season.
